svg.text: The lanes view re-queries a reading past its shelf life, spending the probe read it already made
Each lane is resolved against the reading this composition already holds. The shelf life is the flight key budget.evidence_shelf_life_minutes,
and the probe is the block already read once for that lane's command: a re-query that asked again would be a second invocation.

A lane the probe already describes is not re-queried: its window signature matches and the live block is adopted directly, with
requeried false. The re-query is for the lane the probe did not describe, and a lane whose reading is inside its shelf life is
reported as it stands even though the probe was read and answers, so the re-query is not unconditional.
The lane's own command owns the probe: a second declared pool on that same command does not silence its re-query.
The two trees a composition can write to -- crew/lane-probes and crew/lanes -- are inventoried before and after every case
and must come back identical, because an isolated read does not prove an isolated write.
